nodes.label: Thumbnail Cache
nodes.source_file: docs/archive/prompts/used/phase5 - Prompt 5H: Add thumbnail cache abstraction.md
nodes.rationale: Service/repository storing cover thumbnails in local app storage keyed by release ID or image URL, returning a local path or bytes; deliberately no bulk download or background sync, fails safely on missing URLs or download errors, populated opportunistically after release detail views (5I) and avoids re-downloading existing entries.
